roadmap.title: Descend and finish a run
roadmap.description: Start a standard New Game with every mod disabled. Daily modes, Nightmare and Twitch Integration disable Steam achievements. Follow the main path to the final boss and complete The Work.

roadmap.title: Explore beyond the main path
roadmap.description: Use later attempts to collect the eleven distinct orbs and build the wands needed for the Gods challenges. Finish the guardian challenge before taking Peace with Gods.

roadmap.title: Complete the Progress panels
roadmap.description: Use the Perks, Spells and Enemies panels to track missing entries. Pick up new perks, cast new spells, and defeat creatures outside the main path until each panel reaches 100%.

achievements.summary: Finish a run by completing @mechanic{The Work}.

steps.text: Descend past @loc{Temple of the Art} to @loc{The Laboratory} and pick up the @item{Sampo}.
steps.note: Collecting orbs before taking the Sampo makes the boss stronger.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Kolmisilmä}. Stop firing when the boss fades and gathers your projectiles; the returned shots can hit you.
Enter the red portal left by the boss. At @loc{The Work (End)}, use the prompt to complete The Work.
steps.note: Killing Kolmisilmä alone does not finish the run.

achievements.description: Cast a modified projectile with an infinite lifetime.
achievements.summary: Cast a modified projectile with an infinite lifetime.

guide.context: The modified lifetime must land on exactly -1 frames. Spells that already last forever, such as Rock, do not count.

steps.text: In an uncollapsed @loc{Holy Mountain}, place @item{Reduce Lifetime} immediately before @item{Teleport Bolt} on an otherwise empty non-shuffle wand.
Keep casting the wand until the achievement appears. Teleport Bolt has a random lifetime, so several casts may be needed.

achievements.description: Deal at least 1,000,000 damage in one hit.
achievements.summary: Deal at least 1,000,000 damage in one hit.

guide.context: This build combines gold damage with stacked critical hits. The Water spell applies the wet condition as part of the shot; you do not need to soak the target first.

steps.text: Gather at least @item{504,000 gold} and a non-shuffle wand with at least 15 slots and one spell per cast.
steps.note: Use enough mana capacity to cast the complete spell sequence.

steps.text: Inside an uncollapsed @loc{Holy Mountain}, arrange the wand in this order: @item{Double Spell}, @item{Water}, two copies of @item{Gold To Power}, ten copies of @item{Critical on Wet (Water) Enemies}, then @item{Spark Bolt}.
Fire one full cast into an enemy that takes normal projectile and critical damage. Look for “The gods are afraid”.
steps.note: Both Gold To Power copies need their full damage bonus, so replenish your gold before another attempt if it falls below 504,000.

achievements.description: Reach 100% in the Enemies progress panel.

guide.context: Each row fills one icon in the Enemies panel when you kill that creature. The panel reaches 100% at 185 entries. The left-facing and right-facing turrets share one icon, but each direction adds its own entry, so kill a turret facing each way. Check the panel after each rare kill to confirm the icon filled in.

achievements.description: Reach 100% in the Spells progress panel by casting every required spell.

guide.context: A spell fills its icon only after you cast it once. Buying or carrying it does not count. Most spells turn up freely in Holy Mountain shops, on wands and in chests, and you only need to cast them. The rows below are the spells that stay locked until you do something special, so unlock each one first. Then find it in a Holy Mountain spell shop or on a wand in a later run, and cast it. An orb gives its spell the first time you collect it, so cast it right away. Test dangerous spells away from yourself, because some projectiles and modifiers hurt you.

Water is in the westernmost passage of The Work (Hell). Earth is in a high alcove at the east edge of the world, past the Desert. Air is in the centre of the Cloudscape above the Lake. Spirits is at the bottom of the Lake.
collectibles.note: A Sun already sitting in the Moon stops this from working. The Moon Radar perk helps you find the Moon.

collectibles.name: Omega Black Hole
collectibles.location: Celestial Scale in the @loc{Desert}, just past the @loc{Pyramid}
collectibles.method: Finish the Sun Quest: turn the Moon in The Work (Sky) into a Sun, and the Dark Moon in The Work (Hell) into a Dark Sun. Afterwards the spell sits on top of the Celestial Scale.
collectibles.note: To make each Sun: kill Unohdettu in a Parallel World for a Sun Seed and drop it on top of the Pyramid to get a Sun Stone. Blow the stone up with six explosions at once (or one Summon Sädekivi), and let it kill 100 creatures. Then add Kiuaskivi, Ukkoskivi, Tannerkivi and Vuoksikivi. For the Dark Sun, also add a Kakkakikkare before the last of those stones. The spell shows up on the scale in a run after you finish.

collectibles.name: Omega white hole
collectibles.method: Finish the Sun Quest (steps are in the Omega Black Hole row). The spell is then unlocked and often sold in the shops of The Work (Hell) and The Work (Sky).

collectibles.name: The end of everything
collectibles.method: Kick the three Hand Statues in the Snowy Depths. The third one drops the Broken Spell. Throw it on the Hiisi Anvil in the lower right of Hiisi Base to turn it into Summon Portal. In the Underground Jungle, find the four Munkki statues holding staffs. Cast Summon Portal where the lines from their staffs cross, then take The End of Everything from the metal chest in the Robotic Egg beyond the portal.
collectibles.note: Summon Portal gets a single cast, and any other spot wastes it. Two statues are enough: a north or south statue gives a vertical line, an east or west statue gives a horizontal line, and the portal spot is where they cross. The chest is at the bottom left of the egg, and robots guard the way.

collectibles.name: Summon Omega Sawblade
collectibles.method: Do the same Broken Spell route as The End of Everything and open the metal chest in the Robotic Egg. Opening it unlocks this spell too.
collectibles.note: Steps are in The End of Everything row.

achievements.description: Reach 100% in the Perks progress panel by picking up every required perk.

guide.context: Each Holy Mountain offers three perks on an altar, and taking one removes the other two. A reroll costs 200 gold the first time and doubles with each use. Take a perk whose icon is still empty and reroll when the choices are already filled in. Looking at a perk without taking it does not fill its icon. The last three rows never appear on an altar.

collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Each gold nugget is worth double.

collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Gold from accidental kills is worth four times as much.

collectibles.name: Healthy Exploration

collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You are immune to electricity, but metal and liquids near you keep electrifying.

collectibles.name: All-Seeing Eye
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You can see the whole map.

collectibles.name: Enemy Radar
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You sense enemies nearby.

collectibles.name: Wand Radar
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You sense wands nearby.

collectibles.name: Item Radar
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You sense items nearby.

collectibles.name: Repelling Cape
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You shed stains quickly while moving.

collectibles.name: Exploding Corpses
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Enemies explode when they die, and explosions no longer hurt you.

collectibles.name: More Blood
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Everything bleeds a lot more.

collectibles.name: Invisibility
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You are invisible. Stains, casting, kicking and damage make you visible for a while.

collectibles.name: Slime Blood
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You bleed slime. Slime no longer slows you and you resist projectiles better.

collectibles.name: Oil Blood
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You bleed flammable oil and are immune to fire.

collectibles.name: Gas Blood
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You bleed flammable gas.

collectibles.name: Freeze Field
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Liquids freeze near you.

collectibles.name: Gas Fire
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Gas near you catches fire by itself.

collectibles.name: Dissolve Powders
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Sand and similar powders dissolve quickly near you.

collectibles.name: Worm Attractor
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Worms are drawn to you.

collectibles.name: Feared by Worms
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Worms flee from you, and worms and lukki dig smaller tunnels.

collectibles.name: Cordyceps
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Enemies you kill grow fungal creatures.

collectibles.name: Fungal Colony
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Slime near you turns into fungal creatures.

collectibles.name: Fungal Disease
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Fungal growths sprout on you when danger is near.

collectibles.name: Revenge Explosion
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Taking damage triggers an explosion, and you resist explosions by 25%.

collectibles.name: Revenge Tentacle
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Taking damage summons a tentacle, and you resist projectiles by 25%.

collectibles.name: Revenge Rats
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Taking damage can summon a helpful rat.

collectibles.name: Revenge Bullets
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You fire back when hit by projectiles and resist explosions and projectiles by 20%.

collectibles.name: Lukki Mutation
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You grow extra limbs that fight for you.

collectibles.name: Plague Rats
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Dying enemies release rats that fight for you.

collectibles.name: Spontaneous Generation
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Vomit near you turns into helpful rats.

collectibles.name: Angry Ghost
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. A ghost helps you by copying nearby spells and projectiles.

collectibles.name: Hungry Ghost
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. A ghost minion now and then eats enemy projectiles.

collectibles.name: Mournful Spirit
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Dying creatures leave a spirit that damages a small area.

collectibles.name: Homunculus
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. A homunculus helps you each time you leave a Holy Mountain.

collectibles.name: Lukki Minion
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. A lukki minion joins you.

collectibles.name: Contact Damage
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Enemies close to you take damage, and more of it the lower your health is.

collectibles.name: More Hatred
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Creatures become more hostile to each other.

collectibles.name: More Love
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Creatures become friendlier to each other.

collectibles.name: Projectile Repulsion Field
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Most projectiles are pushed away from you, but you take a bit more projectile damage.

collectibles.name: Projectile Slower
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Projectiles slow down near you.

collectibles.name: Projectile Repulsion Sector
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Projectiles entering a small area in front of you are blown away.

collectibles.name: Projectile Eater
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Projectiles entering a small area behind you vanish.

collectibles.name: Phasing
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Projectiles seem to pass through you.

collectibles.name: Permanent Shield
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You get a small permanent shield.

collectibles.name: Critical Hit +
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You land more critical hits.

collectibles.name: Close Call
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You get extra critical hit chance while enemies are near.

collectibles.name: Homing Shots
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Your spells home in on enemies very slightly.

collectibles.name: Boomerang Spells
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Your spells curve back toward you, with extra speed and damage.

collectibles.name: Unlimited Spells
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Most spells no longer run out of uses.

collectibles.name: Bombs Materialized
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Bomb spells can be carried as throwable items.

collectibles.name: Tinker With Wands Everywhere
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You can edit wands anywhere.

collectibles.name: No Wand Tinkering
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You cannot edit wands, but enemies may drop blood money.

collectibles.name: Extra Knockback on Spells
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Your spells push enemies harder.

collectibles.name: Concentrated Spells
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Your spells are more accurate and stronger, but cast more slowly.

collectibles.name: Low Recoil
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Spell recoil is greatly reduced, but spells fly a little slower.

collectibles.name: Bouncing Spells
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Almost all your spells bounce and last longer.

collectibles.name: Faster Projectiles
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Your projectile spells fly faster.

collectibles.name: Always Cast
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Adds a random always-cast spell to the wand in your hand, up to a maximum of 4.
collectibles.note: Its effect is applied once, when you take it.

collectibles.name: High Mana, Low Capacity
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Your held wand loses half its capacity and gains more mana.
collectibles.note: Its effect is applied once, when you take it.

collectibles.name: No More Shuffle
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Most wands become non-shuffling, including the ones you carry.

collectibles.name: Projectile Duplication
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Your projectile spells may duplicate, but you take more projectile damage.

collectibles.name: Faster Wands
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. All the wands you carry get shorter cast delay and reload time.
collectibles.note: Its effect is applied once, when you take it.

collectibles.name: Extra Wand Capacity
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. The wands you carry gain 1 to 3 spell slots, up to a maximum of 25.
collectibles.note: Its effect is applied once, when you take it.

collectibles.name: Kills to Mana
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Enemies dying near you release mana-restoring liquid.

collectibles.name: Pinpointer
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Your spells fly faster with less spread, and you get an aiming line.

collectibles.name: Personal Plasma Beam
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You constantly fire a strong plasma beam but cast spells much more slowly.

collectibles.name: Summon Sädekivi
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Gives you a stone that calls down a celestial beam.
collectibles.note: Its effect is applied once, when you take it.

collectibles.name: Extra Perk
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Every Holy Mountain from now on offers one extra perk.

collectibles.name: Perk Lottery
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Taking a perk has a 50% chance to keep the others on the altar.

collectibles.name: Gamble
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Gives you two random perks.
collectibles.note: Its effect is applied once, when you take it.

collectibles.name: Extra Item In Holy Mountain
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. Every Holy Mountain you have not yet visited gets one more shop item.

collectibles.name: Peace with Gods
collectibles.method: Take it from the altar when it is offered. You make peace with the gods, so Holy Mountain guards no longer appear.

collectibles.name: Leggy Mutation
collectibles.method: Open chests until a @enemy{Leggy Mimic} wakes, then kill it and pick up @mechanic{Leggy Mutation}.
collectibles.note: The legged variant replaces 5% of ordinary Mimics and wakes when you use the chest's interaction prompt.

collectibles.name: Moon Radar
collectibles.method: Travel east from the @loc{Overgrown Cavern} to the @loc{??? room} and pick up @mechanic{Moon Radar}.

collectibles.name: Spatial Awareness
collectibles.method: Fight @enemy{Kolmisilmän silmä} with ice, slice, drill, holy or electricity damage. Hit it while its projectile-eating shield is open during its firing phases. Collect @mechanic{Spatial Awareness} after the death explosion.
collectibles.note: Ordinary projectile damage does not hurt this boss.

achievements.description: Damage Holy Mountain brickwork after killing three Stevari in one run.
achievements.summary: Damage Holy Mountain brickwork after killing three @enemy{Stevari} in one run.

guide.context: @mechanic{Peace with Gods} suppresses the guardian challenge. Avoid that perk until the achievement unlocks; taking it can be undone during the same run.

steps.text: If you already took @mechanic{Peace with Gods}, remove the perk at the @loc{Nullifying Altar} deep in the Sandcave below the Overgrown Cavern. Fill its left, middle and right basins with Blood, Whiskey and Silver, then leave Peace with Gods behind.
Use @item{Black Hole} to break brickwork around an uncollapsed @loc{Holy Mountain} shop and summon @enemy{Stevari}.
Kill Stevari in three Holy Mountains during the same run. Freeze each guardian with @item{Freeze Charge} or @item{Freezing Gaze}, then kick the frozen guardian.
steps.note: New Holy Mountains spawn a guardian once the gods have been angered.

steps.text: After the third kill, break more brickwork near an uncollapsed Holy Mountain shop if the achievement has not appeared.

achievements.description: Collect each of the eleven distinct ordinary Orbs of True Knowledge at least once.
achievements.summary: Collect the eleven distinct ordinary @item{Orbs of True Knowledge}.

guide.context: Each orb first grants a spell; later visits give maximum health instead. Track distinct locations, since collecting copies of the same orb does not replace a missing location.

collectibles.name: Sea of Lava orb
collectibles.location: Floating island above the starting Mountain
collectibles.method: Reach the island above the mine entrance and collect the orb inside it.

collectibles.name: Earthquake orb
collectibles.location: Top of the Pyramid east of the starting Mountain
collectibles.method: Climb the Pyramid and pick up the orb on top.

collectibles.name: Summon Tentacle orb
collectibles.location: Below the Frozen Vault in the Snowy Wasteland west of the Giant Tree
collectibles.method: Descend beneath the Frozen Vault to collect the orb.

collectibles.name: Nuke orb
collectibles.location: Beneath the Lava Lake east of the Mines
collectibles.method: From the Chasm west wall, use Black Hole to dig down through Extremely Dense Rock below the lava.

collectibles.name: Thundercloud orb
collectibles.location: Orb Room across the abyss east of the Lava Lake
collectibles.method: Cross the rope bridge or climb the Dense Rock wall to reach the room.

collectibles.name: Necromancy orb
collectibles.location: Lowest part of the Sandcave beneath the Pyramid
collectibles.method: Descend through the Sandcave and collect the orb at the bottom.

collectibles.name: Holy Bomb orb
collectibles.location: Orb Room west of the Magical Temple
collectibles.method: Travel left from the Magical Temple to the orb chamber.

collectibles.name: Spiral Shot orb
collectibles.location: Bottom-left of Lukki Lair, west of Underground Jungle
collectibles.method: Explore the lower western edge of Lukki Lair for the orb.

collectibles.name: Summon Deercoy orb
collectibles.location: Bottom of the Snowy Chasm beneath the Snowy Wasteland
collectibles.method: Descend to the bottom of the chasm and collect the orb.

collectibles.name: Cement orb
collectibles.location: Bottom of the Wizard's Den, east of Temple of the Art
collectibles.method: Reach the lowest part of the den to collect the orb.

collectibles.name: Fireworks! orb
collectibles.method: Descend into The Work (Hell) and collect the central orb.
